paragraphs.source_en: A panicked, sudden rain drove me into a dark-clustered mountain hollow, pressing close above my head, writhing and seizing, the savage giant claws of a black dragon; The jujube trees stood gaunt, concealing a silent, ruined temple; with raindrops and clots of rain all over me, I hid inside that dim, sunken, broken temple; The thunderstorm came on still harder: rumbling thunder cracked halfway across the sky, with a tearing roar through forest leaves, roots, and shoots; valleys and mountain rocks howled together, thousands upon thousands of golden shears, golden snakes, flew into the gloomy ruined temple. My whole body shook; by the flash of lightning I took the measure of this ice-cold broken temple; I could not help crying out aloud: lightning blazed like a torch, and lit up, in the shrine beside me, a blue-faced god grinning ferociously. The lightning was gone, and thunder came again; the grinning god vanished from sight. Hard rain poured down like stones-- I alone lay hidden in the ruined temple; A thousand years, ten thousand years must have passed! I only felt every pore of my body, only heard the terrifying strange cries, only remembered that fierce and evil god, and forgot the ruined temple I was in; At long last the rain stopped, the thunder rested; the blood-red sun shone across the whole sky, revealing one self, one ruined temple! Composed in June 1923

units.source_en: A panicked, sudden rain drove me into a dark-clustered mountain hollow, pressing close above my head, writhing and seizing, the savage giant claws of a black dragon;
units.source_zh:
慌張的急雨將我

趕入了黑叢叢的山坳，

迫近我頭頂的騰拿，

惡狠狠的烏龍巨爪；

units.source_en: The jujube trees stood gaunt, concealing a silent, ruined temple; with raindrops and clots of rain all over me, I hid inside that dim, sunken, broken temple;
units.source_zh:
棗樹兀兀的隱蔽著

一座靜悄悄的破廟，

我滿身的雨點雨塊，

躲進了昏沈沈的破廟；

units.source_en: The thunderstorm came on still harder: rumbling thunder cracked halfway across the sky, with a tearing roar through forest leaves, roots, and shoots; valleys and mountain rocks howled together, thousands upon thousands of golden shears, golden snakes, flew into the gloomy ruined temple. My whole body shook; by the flash of lightning I took the measure of this ice-cold broken temple;
units.source_zh:
雷雨越發來得大了：

霍隆隆半天裏霹靂，

豁喇喇林葉樹根苗，

山谷山石，一齊怒號，

千萬條的金剪金蛇，

飛入陰森森的破廟，

我渾身戰抖，趁電光

估量這冷冰冰的破廟；

units.source_en: I could not help crying out aloud: lightning blazed like a torch, and lit up, in the shrine beside me, a blue-faced god grinning ferociously. The lightning was gone, and thunder came again; the grinning god vanished from sight. Hard rain poured down like stones-- I alone lay hidden in the ruined temple;
units.source_zh:
我禁不住大聲啼噭：

電光火把似的照耀，

照出我身旁神龕裏

一個青面獰笑的神道，

電光去了，霹靂又到，

不見了獰笑的神道，

硬雨石塊似的倒瀉──

我獨身藏躲在破廟；

units.source_en: A thousand years, ten thousand years must have passed!
I only felt every pore of my body, only heard the terrifying strange cries, only remembered that fierce and evil god, and forgot the ruined temple I was in;
units.source_zh:
只覺得渾身的毛竅，

只聽得駭人的怪叫，

只記得那兇惡的神道，

忘了我現在的破廟；

units.source_en: At long last the rain stopped, the thunder rested; the blood-red sun shone across the whole sky, revealing one self, one ruined temple!
units.source_zh:
好容易雨收了，雷休了，

血紅的太陽，滿天照耀，

照出一個我，一座破廟！

paragraphs.source_zh:
慌張的急雨將我

趕入了黑叢叢的山坳，

迫近我頭頂的騰拿，

惡狠狠的烏龍巨爪；

棗樹兀兀的隱蔽著

一座靜悄悄的破廟，

我滿身的雨點雨塊，

躲進了昏沈沈的破廟；

雷雨越發來得大了：

霍隆隆半天裏霹靂，

豁喇喇林葉樹根苗，

山谷山石，一齊怒號，

千萬條的金剪金蛇，

飛入陰森森的破廟，

我渾身戰抖，趁電光

估量這冷冰冰的破廟；

我禁不住大聲啼噭：

電光火把似的照耀，

照出我身旁神龕裏

一個青面獰笑的神道，

電光去了，霹靂又到，

不見了獰笑的神道，

硬雨石塊似的倒瀉──

我獨身藏躲在破廟；

千年萬年應該過了！

只覺得渾身的毛竅，

只聽得駭人的怪叫，

只記得那兇惡的神道，

忘了我現在的破廟；

好容易雨收了，雷休了，

血紅的太陽，滿天照耀，

照出一個我，一座破廟！

一九二三年六月作
